verdict.rationale: Trivy does not document its own built-in AI assistant. Its official trivy-mcp plugin starts an MCP server so external MCP-enabled tools such as VS Code can run Trivy scans. That lets users ask security questions in natural language, but only through an external AI client. missing for 10: a native in-product AI assistant, documentation of task delegation within Trivy itself, independent or hands-on corroboration of the natural-language scanning.
